items.title: UConn clinches bowl eligibility with win over ODU
items.summary: The UConn Huskies (6-5) celebrated Senior Day with a 29-21 victory over the Old Dominion Monarchs (3-8) to clinch the program’s third consecutive year of bowl eligibility. Quarterback Kalieb Osborne completed 12 of 22 (54.6%) passes for 239 yards, a touchdown and a pick. In the backfield, Cyncir Bowers led with 105 rushing yards for […]

items.title: Huskies Earn Bowl Eligibility with Win Over Old Dominion
items.summary: STORRS, CT – The UConn Huskies posted a 29-21 win over Old Dominion on Saturday afternoon in front of 27,006 fans at Pratt & Whitney Stadium at Rentschler Field and reached bowl eligibility for the third-straight season.

items.title: Football: Huskies vie for bowl eligibility in Senior Day matchup against Old Dominion
items.summary: Sitting just one win away from their third-straight bowl game, the University of Connecticut Huskies welcome the Old Dominion Monarchs to Rentschler Field on Saturday afternoon.

items.title: Elliot’s CFP Rankings: Third edition of the 2026 College Football Playoff rankings and reactions
items.summary: The CFP committee released its third week of playoff rankings, and fans are taking the internet by storm. The newest rankings kept the top four teams the same while dropping three out of the top 25. The important thing to note is how the 12-team bracket only includes the top 11 teams ranked, along with the highest-ranked Group of Five team as the No. 12 seed.

items.title: Huskies Host ODU for Senior Day
Kick-Off and TV Info Announced for Wyoming Game
items.summary: STORRS, CT - The kick-off time and TV broadcast information for UConn at Wyoming on Saturday, November 28 was announced on Monday.  The Huskies and Cowboys will kick-off at 12:00 pm EST with the game being broadcast on FS1.

items.title: Osborne Named to Week 11 Manning Award Stars of the Week
items.summary: STORRS, CT - Quarterback Kalieb Osborne was named to the Week 11 Manning Award Stars of the Week after leading the Huskies past James Madison on Saturday.

items.title: QB Kalieb Osborne Named to Davey O'Brien Great 8
items.summary: STORRS, CT - UConn quarterback Kalieb Osborne was named to the Davey O'Brien Award Great 8 for week 11 thanks to his performance in leading the Huskies to a 46-22 win over James Madison over the weekend. The Davey O'Brien National Quarterback of the Week, selected from the Great 8 list, will be revealed Tuesday at 11 a.m. (CT).

items.title: Huskies Rout James Madison
items.summary: EAST HARTFORD, CT – UConn quarterback Kalieb Osborne threw for 274 yards and three touchdowns and had 88 yards rushing to lead the Huskies to a 46-22 win over James Madison in front of 25,530 at Pratt & Whitney Stadium at Rentschler Field Saturday afternoon.

items.title: Huskies Lose Battle With Tar Heels
items.summary: EAST HARTFORD, CT – The North Carolina Tar Heels created three turnovers leading to 21 points on the way to a 38-21 win over the UConn Huskies Saturday afternoon in front of 36,901 at Pratt & Whitney Stadium at Rentschler Field.
